*~11,606 tokens/session saved*
- The `model` and `xml-parser` Gradle modules point via `srcDirs` to external checkouts: `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/model/src/...` and `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/xml-parser/src/...` — NOT under `AndroidStudioProjects/Scythebill`. ### Frequently-Edited Large Files
*~8,500 tokens/session saved*
- `TaxonomyBrowseScreen.kt`, `QueryBuilderScreen.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, `SightingCacheBuilder.kt`, `CacheEntity.kt`, and `Trips.java` (in the external model checkout) are hot files that get Read repeatedly across multi-step tasks in this repo. ### Gradle Build Commands
*~6,700 tokens/session saved*
- Do NOT prefix `./gradlew` with `timeout N` — this fails with `command_not_found` in this shell. Run gradlew directly, e.g. `./gradlew :model:compileKotlinJvm --console=plain 2>&1 | tail -150`.
- Prefer `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin -q 2>&1 | tail -100` for routine edit/compile cycles (succeeds silently on 31-byte OK output); only switch to `--console=plain 2>&1 | tail -150` when diagnosing an actual failure, to avoid redundant near-identical compile invocations.

### App Launch / `run` Skill
*~400 tokens/session saved*
- This project has no `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` directory — the `run` skill's initial glob check for a project-specific launch skill always returns `no_matches`. Skip that check and go straight to `adb devices` / `./gradlew :app:installDebug` when launching the app.

### Repository Layout
*~45,000 tokens/session saved*
- The `model` and `xml-parser` Gradle modules in this repo (AndroidStudioProjects/Scythebill) point via `srcDirs` at source trees in a SEPARATE checkout: `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/model/src/main/java/...` and `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/xml-parser/src/main/java/...`. There is no `model/src` or `xml-parser/src` directory inside AndroidStudioProjects/Scythebill itself — searching there fails with 'No such file or directory'. Always grep/read model & xml-parser business logic from `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/...`.
- Android-side app code (Compose UI, cache, DI) lives under `app/src/main/java/com/scythebill/birdlist/android/`.

### Environment / Tooling
*~8,000 tokens/session saved*
- The bundled `find` wrapper (rtk) does not support compound predicates like `-not`/`-exec`; use plain `find` (or `/usr/bin/find`) directly when those are needed.
- In zsh, quote glob patterns passed to grep, e.g. `grep --include="*.kt"` — unquoted `--include=*.kt` errors with 'no matches found'.
- Verify Kotlin compiles with `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin -q 2>&1 | tail -100` before considering an edit done.
